site.name: Social Conclave
site.institution: NMIMS · Mukesh Patel School of Technology Management & Engineering
site.intro: People. Ideas. Dialogue. A place to begin thinking about the change you want to be part of.
site.about: Start with a question. Listen to another perspective. Find something you can do. This draft of Social Conclave’s 10th edition brings that invitation together: explore your interests, revisit the editions, and make a small plan of your own.

topics.title: Climate & environment
topics.description: Explore the choices that shape our environment, from everyday habits to the places we call home.
topics.action: Notice one thing your campus could waste less of. Write down a practical first step.

topics.title: Education & access
topics.description: Think about who gets to learn, the barriers they face, and what students can share with one another.
topics.action: List one skill you could share with a peer, and one you would like to learn.

topics.title: Technology for good
topics.description: Look at technology through the needs of people, rather than starting with a solution.
topics.action: Choose an everyday community problem. Write three questions to ask before building anything.

topics.title: Health & wellbeing
topics.description: Make space to consider wellbeing, supportive environments and the everyday experience of care.
topics.action: Take a quiet moment to note what helps you feel supported and what you would like to understand better.

topics.title: Social enterprise
topics.description: Explore how an idea can serve a community and sustain the work it takes to do so.
topics.action: Sketch an idea in three lines: who it serves, what it changes, and what resources it would need.

topics.title: Equality & inclusion
topics.description: Consider access, representation and whose perspective might be missing from a conversation.
topics.action: Reflect on one space you use: who might find it hard to participate, and what question could you ask?

paths.title: Be part of the conversation
paths.label: For the curious
paths.description: Explore the themes that matter to you. Save your interests while participation details are being confirmed.

paths.title: Bring something of your own
paths.label: For the contributors
paths.description: Make a note of a question, skill or perspective you would like to share. Official contribution routes are not listed yet.

paths.title: Find a way to work together
paths.label: For the collaborators
paths.description: Committee contact and collaboration details need confirmation. No partnership or affiliation is implied by this draft.
